what_this_is: Phase 3's audit of the parity/integration test class. `__tests__/testQuality.test.js` reads this file and fails if a listed test loses its provenance fixture, its fixture-sourced leaf assertion, or its cached-equals-returned assertion. It also lints every fixture file for the three-line provenance header.

integrationTests.stub: Open-Meteo single object and multi array, captured from the live API
real full single-point object with hourly/daily series + real two-point array
deployed forecast snapshot (trimmed capture, real rows)
integrationTests.cacheNote: This route answers no-store, max-age=0; there is no cached object to compare. The cache-equality rule is enforced on the weather cache in pagesWeather and cacheContract instead.

integrationTests.stub: deployed alert artifact with stamped policy (captured); synthetic store documents remain only for DRAFT/REJECTED unit cases
integrationTests.cacheNote: Snapshot-backed route with a CDN cache header, not an in-process object cache; the returned object is asserted directly against the captured artifact.

integrationTests.stub: browser streaming tracker SendBatch payload (a request fixture, not an upstream response)
same captured client beacon; the `toMatchObject` presence assertion was replaced with `toEqual` over fixture leaves
real upstream weather fixtures + deployed forecast/alert artifacts + captured beacon
real captured single-point object; the hollow `{id,_meta}` point is a permanent negative fixture defined in the test
negative-control JSON snapshot fixture with a provenance sidecar (deliberately not an upstream mirror)

auditedWithoutStub.reason: Playwright black-box specs: they call the deployed origin and assert on real DOM/HTTP responses. There is no stub to mirror and no in-process cache to compare; a fixture here would be a step backwards. Their value assertions are on live response bodies and status codes.

dispositioned.reason: 2026-10-27 dated disposition. The first three are Node-only pipeline suites with local CSV/ZIP fixtures generated inside the test (documented at the top of each file); Kaggle is dispositioned in Phase 4 and the wind pipeline is an Actions job. `chatService.test.js` stubs a key-authenticated LLM provider (api.groq.com) — there is no reproducible, credential-free upstream response to capture — and that route is Node-only per Action 21. All four already assert leaf values from their synthetic inputs, but the bytes are test inputs rather than captured upstream responses; they are explicitly not claimed as upstream-mirroring fixtures. If any gains a live upstream response in CI, it must move into integrationTests with a provenance header. `pagesAlerts`' synthetic store documents are likewise limited to DRAFT/REJECTED unit cases; its integration assertions use the captured artifact.
